label: Applying to Maastricht University for autumn 2027

milestones.label: Studielink opens for 2027-2028
milestones.note: Maastricht states applications open on 1 October and, for University College Maastricht, are reviewed on a rolling basis from then — so applying in October is materially different from applying in March.

milestones.label: University College Maastricht closes for non-EU/EEA applicants
milestones.note: Studielink application and every admission task in Maastricht's own MyApplication portal, both by this date.

milestones.label: International Business numerus fixus application closes
milestones.note: The national numerus fixus date. Maastricht's published table gives 15 January 2026 for the 2026-2027 round; the 2027 date is inherited from the national rule and is provisional until Maastricht republishes. Studielink and all MyApplication admission tasks must both be complete.

milestones.label: University College Maastricht closes for EU/EEA and Swiss applicants
milestones.note: Neither 15 January nor 1 May. UCM is selective without being numerus fixus and sets its own date.

milestones.label: Data Science and AI closes for non-EU/EEA applicants
Data Science and AI closes for EU/EEA and Swiss applicants
milestones.note: The ordinary national date, because this programme is not capped.

milestones.label: International Business ranking number published
milestones.note: Also the date on which an applicant is told they failed the International Classroom requirement and are not in the ranking at all.

milestones.label: Mathematics sufficiency syllabus, EU/EEA and Swiss applicants
milestones.note: Only if Maastricht judges your mathematics short of the requirement. A deficiency here is a process rather than a refusal, and it must be cleared before the first year starts.

milestones.label: All enrolment tasks complete
milestones.note: Including the certified copy of your diploma — which is why IB results arriving in early July is workable here: the diploma is an enrolment task, not an admission task.

notes: Maastricht runs three different calendars at once and this route holds all three, because they are three properties of one university rather than three routes a student chooses between. Which milestones bind depends on the Opportunity and, for two of them, on nationality.

The split between admission tasks and enrolment tasks is the answer to the July problem at this university: the certified diploma is due on 31 August, after IB results. Whether the other Dutch institutions in this catalogue work the same way was not established.
